description: Take status: queued/running/succeeded/failed + video file, last frame, token spend, and what the take was shot as: model, resolution, ratio, duration and referenceVideoSec (seconds of @clips it was billed for). A failed take carries error, words to act on, and errorCode when the studio knows the kind: OUTPUT_REFUSED is the provider's filter refusing the finished video — nothing was charged, and the same request mostly gets the same answer. A Seedance 2.5 draft carries draft: true and final — its live 1080p final, or null; a final carries finishOf, the draft it was made from.
name: take_status
